answer.label: Not Walt Whitman — Lucy Maud Montgomery
answer.sourceLine: The exact sentence appears in Montgomery’s The Golden Road (1913), chapter 27. Whitman wrote a different poem about continuity; it is not the source of this sentence.

misattribution.heading: Often misattributed
misattribution.intro: The Whitman attribution is wrong for this wording. Montgomery’s novel, rather than her earlier The Story Girl, supplies the exact sentence.
